content.text: Remember to un-Ignore the BibframeIT test when this ticket is resolved:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/f016047386f25068fcd59da1d015fbe6fad3d413
, now that
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1993
is resolved, is this current ticket still an issue?
The test is still failed after remove @Ignore
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-integration-rdf/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/integration/rdf/BibframeIT.java#L29
in Windows.
Thus, this ticket still has an issue.
PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1160
Been tested on a Windows 10 machine and executed "maven install". All test are passed. (01/20/17)
, can you verify this build on a Windows machine?
It builds OK,
https://gist.github.com/anonymous/c12c079795f4c5d097dc9a72890fa7d6
The first time I ran "mvn clean install", however, I did get 2 apparently unrelated spurious failure from fcrepo kernel impl modeshape.
Built on Windows 7 machine w/ Java 1.8.0_121.
Thanks,
was also curious of the exact PR that may have fixed this issue. There have been a few encoding updates that may have resulted in the fix.
It would be interesting to us "git bisect" to pinpoint the PR that is responsible, if you have the time.
I decided to give this ticket another try by instinct after I saw this
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2370
, can you verify that this issue is broken before and fixed after the commit associated with FCREPO-2370?
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/1bf56b18b2f629b911be2fa0bb08f54d00b36908
I have verified that this issue is broken before and fixed after the commit associated with
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/1bf56b18b2f629b911be2fa0bb08f54d00b36908
Related commit removing @Ignore in Bibframe test:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/0bb3da2a59f679b8bed3ce52fc8443aeb4704032
Some platforms (such as Windows) may send client requests with encodings other than UTF-8.  The Fedora HTTP service should detect non-UTF8 requests, and handle them gracefully.
Common on Windows machines, where the default platform charset encoding is Cp1252.
